strengths: Strong empirical validation across diverse model families (LLaMA, Qwen, Gemma, Mistral, Phi), domains (WikiText, CNN Daily News, PubMed), and model sizes with consistent correlations (r = -0.47 to -0.92)

Comprehensive analysis including layer-wise progression, semantic cluster analysis (Figure 7) showing both within and between-cluster dispersion increases, fine-tuning effects, and held-out generalization

Four practical applications with demonstrated utility: label-free hardness ranking with monotonic relationships, model selection with Spearman ρ > 0.95 perfect rankings, efficient kNN-LM layer selection, and training improvements (especially in cross-domain scenarios)

Direct evidence for causality: ablation study (squeeze experiment) shows clustering embeddings hurts performance by 18+ perplexity points; training trajectory analysis on Olmo-7B with 30 checkpoints shows ρ=0.90-0.95
Methodologically rigorous with uniform perplexity binning, multiple random seeds, error bars throughout, detailed hyperparameters, and honest discussion of limitations
Thorough reproducibility with 38-page appendix, full experimental protocols, and code availability promised; comparison to perplexity as hardness signal showing dispersion outperforms
Clear intuitive presentation with well-motivated figures that establish core ideas early and structured narrative from observation to applications
weaknesses: Primarily observational without mechanistic explanation: lacks theoretical understanding of why dispersion correlates with perplexity; unclear if correlation is causal or both consequences of deeper training dynamics

Metric choice under-justified: why average pairwise cosine distance specifically over other geometric properties (L2 distance, spectral methods, intrinsic dimension)? Vendi Score validation helpful but limited

Causality direction unclear despite ablation support: does high dispersion cause low perplexity or vice versa? Auxiliary loss gains modest in single-domain setting (1-4 ppl) raises questions about practical importance

Limited experimental scope: training improvements tested only on GPT-2-SMALL (scaling unknown), cross-domain training only WikiText+code, multilingual results present but underemphasized, only decoder-only Transformers tested, no non-English language focus

Application limitations: model selection requires manual domain-specific token selection and works only within family/tokenizer; hardness ranking requires forward passes; kNN-LM has limited practical adoption; training improvements are incremental

Missing comparisons: no comparison to other embedding quality metrics (entropy, uncertainty quantification, calibration, rank, intrinsic dimension); related work on anisotropy/rank collapse cited but not deeply engaged

Ad-hoc design choices: dispersion gap formula weights within(T) and between equally without justification; final layer choice appears arbitrary; semantic clustering analysis depends on specific 10-gram artifact

Presentation issues: title slightly overclaims ('predictive power' vs. correlation); notation inconsistencies (D vs D-bar); figure overplotting in scatter plots; some standard errors large for smaller models
